2ND ANNUAL CONFERENCE 
CANADIAN COUNCIL OF 
CHRISTIANS AND JEWS 

AT YMCA OTOREKE LODGE 
ST. ADOLPHE DE HOWARD 


METROPOLITAN YMCA 
OF MONTREAL 


FROM THE INFORMATION OFFICE 
Vie h-0131 Local 140 
GERALD WRIGHT DIRECTOR 


SIR GEORGE WILLIAMS 
UNIVERSITY AND SCHOOLS 


June Ihth,- 1963 


IN THE RELAXED SETTING OF A LAURENTIAN CONFERENCE LODGE,. 
TWO SOCIOLOGY PROFESSORS SPENT THE WEEKEND IN CLOSE CON- 
SULTATION WITH 130 ENGLISH AND FRENCH SPEAKING CHRISTIANS 


AND JEWS ON THE SUBJECT OF "CULTURAL PLURALISM IN CANADA", 


THE SOCIOLOGISTS, -HUBERT GUINDON FROM SIR GEORGE WILLIAMS 
UNIVERSITY AND MARCEL RIOUX FROM THE UNIVERSITY OF MONTREAL, 
HELPED THE YOUNG ADULT GROUP WORK OUT SOME FRESH VIEW- 
“OINTS ON ENGLISH-FRENCH RELATIONS AND ON THE RIGHTS OF 
OTHER RACIAL AND RELIGIOUS GROUPS IN CANADA. THE CON- 
FERENCE WAS SPONSORED BY THE CANADIAN COUNCIL OF CHRISTIANS 


AND JEWS.
